sources.title: Cal. Code Regs. Tit. 22, § 70217 — Nursing Service Staff (LII)
sources.key_facts: Establishes mandatory nurse-to-patient ratios by unit: ICU 1:2 (§70217(a)(1)), Med/Surg 1:5 eff. 2005-01-01 (§70217(a)(11)), Step-Down 1:3 eff. 2008-01-01 (§70217(a)(9)), Telemetry 1:4 eff. 2008-01-01 (§70217(a)(10)), ED 1:4 / critical trauma 1:1 RN-only (§70217(a)(8)), Psychiatric 1:6 (§70217(a)(13)). Charge nurse counts toward ratio ONLY when providing direct patient care. Staffing records must be maintained shift-by-shift for minimum one year (§70217(d)).

sources.title: California Health & Safety Code § 1276.4 — Minimum Nurse Staffing Ratios (OneCle)
sources.key_facts: Statutory authority directing CDPH to adopt minimum specific numerical nurse-to-patient ratios by January 1, 2002. Covers general acute care hospitals under § 1250(a)(b)(f). Amended by Stats. 2012, Ch. 24 (AB 1470), effective June 27, 2012. Allows rural hospital waivers per § 70059.1. Cross-references Title 22 §§ 70053.2, 70215, 70217.

sources.title: California H&SC § 1280.3 — Administrative Penalties for Staffing Ratio Violations (Justia 2024)
sources.key_facts: First violation: $15,000 administrative penalty. Second and subsequent violations: $30,000 each. Multiple violations found during the same inspection = single violation. Violation occurring 3+ years after last violation resets to first-violation tier. Established by SB 227 (signed October 12, 2019). CDPH conducts unannounced periodic inspections.

sources.title: CDPH AFL-23-27 — All Facilities Letter: Enforcement Guidance on Nurse Staffing Ratio Penalties (Sep 2023)
sources.key_facts: Published September 2023. Confirms $15,000 first / $30,000 subsequent penalty structure. Defines three-prong exemption defense: (1) fluctuation was unpredictable and uncontrollable; (2) prompt efforts made to maintain staffing; (3) hospital immediately used and subsequently exhausted on-call list. Seasonal flu peaks explicitly stated as NOT automatically qualifying as unpredictable. CDPH may issue additional penalty if inadequate staffing resulted in patient harm.

sources.title: California SB 596 — Health Facilities: Administrative Penalties (signed October 13, 2025)
sources.key_facts: Effective January 1, 2026. Each day of non-compliance constitutes a separate and distinct violation. Redefines 'on-call list': only nurses scheduled to be on-call for that specific shift and unit, or nurses in a regularly scheduled float pool. Facilities cannot satisfy compliance by contacting nurses not on the formal on-call roster. Applies to general acute care hospitals, acute psychiatric hospitals, and special hospitals.

sources.title: Oregon HB 2697 — Safe Nurse Staffing Law (2023 Regular Session, signed August 11, 2023)
sources.key_facts: Oregon becomes second state with mandatory nurse staffing ratios. ICU ratio: 1:2 (same as California). Med/Surg: 1:5 effective June 1, 2024, decreasing to 1:4 effective June 1, 2026. ED: avg 1:4 per shift, hard max 1:5; trauma patients 1:1. CNA ratios: day shift 1:7, night shift 1:11. Eliminates 'buddy break' system. Enforcement (investigations and fines up to $5,000 for repeated violations) begins June 1, 2025.

sources.title: Massachusetts MGL c. 111 § 231 / 958 CMR 8.00 — ICU Patient Assignment Law (HPC)
sources.key_facts: Legislation: Chapter 155 of Acts of 2014. Regulation: 958 CMR 8.00, effective July 3, 2015. ICU RN assignment: 1:1 or 1:2 depending on patient stability as assessed by certified acuity tool. Assigning a third patient to an ICU nurse is strictly prohibited under any circumstances. DPH certifies acuity tools; HPC defers to DPH on enforcement.

sources.title: Increased Utilization of Overtime and Agency Nurses and Patient Safety — PMC (2024)
sources.key_facts: Quality improvement study of 70 US hospitals, January 2019 – December 2022. Mean total RN/LPN HPPD: 2.14. Agency composition: 6.8% of RN hours (0.09 HPPD); overtime: 4.5% (0.09 HPPD). Agency hours 140% over safety threshold; overtime 63.6% over safe threshold. 6.44% increase in pressure ulcers (PSI-3) tied to excess agency staffing; 2.09% increase from overtime. Pressure ulcers affect 2.5 million US patients/year, costing up to $72,000 per stay.

sources.title: Joint Commission NPG 12 — Health Professional Resource Management (effective January 1, 2026)
sources.key_facts: Effective January 1, 2026. NPG.12.01.01: leadership ensures adequate number and mix of qualified staff based on patient needs. NPG.12.02.01 EP1-2: nurse executive directs staffing plans and participates in governance. NPG.12.02.01 EP4-5: 24/7 registered nursing oversight. NPG.12.06.01 EP1-4: staffing evaluated in QAPI; results reported to leadership and governing body. Documentation required: acuity-based staffing analysis, variance reports, correlation data linking staffing to quality/safety indicators.

sources.title: CDPH Health Facilities State Enforcement Actions Dataset (CHHS Open Data Portal)
sources.key_facts: Dataset covers enforcement actions July 1, 1997 through June 30, 2024. Fields: enforcement action type, violation category, penalty amount, violation date, appeal status, facility name. Downloadable as XLSX and CSV. Covers 30+ types of healthcare facilities. Tags include 'NHPPD' (nursing hours per patient day) tracking.

sources.title: National Nurses United — What California Ratios Law Requires
sources.key_facts: Confirms ratios apply 'at all times' including meals and breaks. 'No averaging' of patients and RNs permitted. Unlicensed personnel cannot perform nursing functions including medication administration, venipuncture, invasive procedures. Additional RNs must be added above minimums based on documented patient classification system measuring acuity, illness severity, and care complexity.

anchors.name: A1: ICU 护患比
anchors.note: § 70217(a)(1); covers ICU, burn center, coronary care, acute respiratory, NICU; effective 2004-01-01

anchors.name: A3: Step-Down 护患比
anchors.note: § 70217(a)(9); step-down = moderate-to-severe physiologic instability, technical support but not artificial life support

anchors.name: A5: ED 护患比
anchors.note: § 70217(a)(8); critical trauma patients restricted to RN assignment only

anchors.name: A6: Psychiatric 护患比
anchors.note: § 70217(a)(13); psychiatric technician may count in psychiatric units only

anchors.name: A7: 首次违规罚款
anchors.note: H&SC § 1280.3; established by SB 227 signed 2019-10-12; confirmed in CDPH AFL-23-27

anchors.name: A8: 再次违规罚款
anchors.note: H&SC § 1280.3; resets to first-violation tier after 3 years without violation

anchors.name: A9: SB 596 日罚款变化
anchors.value: Effective 2026-01-01: each calendar day of non-compliance = separate violation
anchors.note: Signed by Governor Newsom 2025-10-13; previously multiple violations in same inspection = 1 violation

anchors.name: A10: 豁免三要件
anchors.value: (1) unpredictable/uncontrollable fluctuation; (2) prompt efforts made; (3) immediately used and exhausted on-call list
anchors.note: AFL-23-27 Sep 2023; seasonal flu not automatically qualifying; emergency circumstances not automatically qualifying

anchors.name: A11: Charge Nurse 计入规则
anchors.value: Counts toward ratio ONLY when engaged in direct patient care
anchors.note: § 70217 interpretive language; administrative/supervisory duties exclude from ratio count

anchors.name: A12: Oregon ICU 比率
anchors.note: Oregon HB 2697; same as California; enforcement begins 2025-06-01

anchors.name: A13: Oregon Med/Surg Phase-in
anchors.note: California remains at 1:5; Oregon will be stricter than California by 2026

anchors.name: A14: Oregon 违规罚款上限
anchors.note: Far below California first-violation penalty of $15,000

anchors.name: A15: Agency 护士安全阈值
anchors.value: Agency HPPD breakpoint: 0.090; study hospitals exceeded by 140%
anchors.note: 70-hospital study 2019-2022; 6.44% increase in pressure ulcers (PSI-3) associated with excess agency staffing

anchors.name: A16: Massachusetts ICU 法规
anchors.value: 1:1 or 1:2 based on patient stability (acuity tool); maximum of 2 patients per ICU RN; third patient strictly prohibited

anchors.name: A17: Joint Commission NPG 12
anchors.value: Effective 2026-01-01; nurse executive directs staffing plan; 24/7 RN oversight; staffing evaluated in QAPI (NPG.12.06.01)
anchors.note: First time nurse staffing tied to accreditation; replaces former NPSG chapter

anchors.name: A18: 记录保存要求
anchors.value: Maintain actual nurse-patient assignment records on day-to-day, shift-by-shift basis for minimum 1 year
anchors.note: § 70217(d); records must be immediately available for CDPH inspection review
